local YT_LINK = "https://youtu.be/T1-wkgOJWps"

local function openURL(url)
    if syn and syn.open_url then
        syn.open_url(url)
    elseif KRNL_openurl then
        KRNL_openurl(url)
    elseif rconsoleprint then
        -- fallback: copy ke clipboard
        setclipboard(url)
        game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "Link Disalin!",
            Text = "Paste di browser kamu.",
            Duration = 4
        })
        return
    else
        setclipboard(url)
        game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "Link Disalin!",
            Text = "Paste di browser kamu.",
            Duration = 4
        })
        return
    end
end

local function notify(title, text)
    game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = title,
        Text = text,
        Duration = 3
    })
end
